# SuperDispatch

> The scheduler for SuperPipeline and AgentPod: when a card is ready, it decides which agent should take it, and records why.

SuperDispatch places SuperPipeline cards onto AgentPod agents by capability, load and history. For each ready card it filters every candidate (each rejection carries a reason code), scores the ones left and names a preferred agent; SuperPipeline then holds the card for that agent for a short reservation that expires on its own. Every decision is recorded with every candidate and the reason for each. Roster and supply changes it finds are advice for a person to act on; it never edits a roster or a station. Nothing requires it: an agent outside it keeps working by pull. It is early: proven end to end on staging, and v0.0.1 runs in production with no board opted in yet. It is an Apache-2.0 Bun service.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/SuperJackfruitLabs/superdispatch#readme): what it does, every setting, the operator API
